comparison.objective: Fit and center a gasket between spread pipe flanges and insert four bolts; candidate separates ceramic media from washers in a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-part insertion into a constrained gap, flange preservation and precision bolt placement versus bimanual screen lifting, agitation, selective passage and support replacement.
comparison.success_condition: Centered flat gasket, undisturbed upper flange, bolts seated through matching holes and released dwell versus ≥98% media recovery, all washers retained, no spill, screen supported and hands clear. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: Although both use apertures, the flange task tests precision assembly into specific holes, while the candidate tests many-body size classification by passage through a sieve.
